title: 才 vs 就 in Chinese: Later or Earlier Than Expected (HSK 3)
description: 才 (cái) vs 就 (jiù) in Chinese: "not until" vs "as early as", quick or slow, 才 for "only", 就 and 才 after a condition, common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: 才 vs 就: "Only Then" or "Already"
lede: 才 (cái) and 就 (jiù) both go before the verb and show how the speaker feels about the timing. 就 says something happened early, quickly or easily; 才 says it happened late, slowly or with difficulty.

sections.h2: 就 is early, 才 is late
paras: Time + 就 + verb + 了. Time + 才 + verb.

Both words come after the time word and straight before the verb. 就 says something happened earlier than expected. 才 says it happened later than expected, like "not until" in English. For something that has already happened, a 就 sentence usually ends in 了, but a 才 sentence doesn't.

examples.py: Tā liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
examples.en: He was up as early as six.
He didn't get up until ten.

examples.zh: 电影七点开始，他七点半才到。
examples.py: Diànyǐng qī diǎn kāishǐ, tā qī diǎn bàn cái dào.
examples.en: The film started at seven, but he didn't arrive until half past.

sections.h2: Quick or slow, young or old
paras: The same idea works with lengths of time and with ages. With 就, it took less time than expected or happened at a young age. With 才, it took a long time or came late.

examples.py: Wǒ bàn ge xiǎoshí jiù zuòwán le.
examples.en: I finished it in just half an hour.

examples.py: Tā sān ge xiǎoshí cái zuòwán.
examples.en: It took him three hours to finish.

examples.py: Tā èrshí'èr suì jiù jiéhūn le.
examples.en: He was already married at twenty-two.
She didn't get married until she was thirty-eight.

paras: Straight before a number, 才 means "only": the speaker thinks the number is small. It is often used with ages, clock times and prices.

examples.zh: 现在才六点，你再睡一会儿吧。
examples.py: Xiànzài cái liù diǎn, nǐ zài shuì yíhuìr ba.
examples.en: It's only six. Go back to sleep for a bit.

paras: After a condition, 就 means "then": if the first thing happens, the second follows. 才 means "only then": the second thing happens only if the first one does.

examples.en: I'll only go if you go.

paras: The most common mistake is putting 了 at the end of a 才 sentence about the past. Say 他十点才来, not 他十点才来了.
Neither word can go at the end of the sentence. When they mean "late" or "early", put them after the subject and the time word, straight before the verb.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡觉。
examples.py: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn cái shuìjiào.
examples.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.

examples.py: Wǒmen bā diǎn jiù dào le.
examples.en: We got there as early as eight.

worksheet.title: 才 vs 就 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 才 vs 就 worksheet for HSK 3: 20 exercises (choose 才 or 就, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 才 or 就 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: He didn't go to bed until one o'clock last night.
I was up as early as five this morning.
I finished this book in just two days.
I waited half an hour before the bus finally came.

items.zh: 弟弟＿＿六岁，还不会写很多字。
items.en: My little brother is only six, so he can't write many characters yet.
If you're going, then I'll go.

items.zh: 他学了三年＿＿会说一点儿汉语。
items.en: It took him three years to be able to speak a little Chinese.

items.zh: 飞机十点起飞，他九点＿＿到机场了。
items.en: The plane took off at ten, and he got to the airport as early as nine.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: He didn't come until ten.
She left as early as five.
Only now do I understand.
We got there in just ten minutes.
This dish is only ten kuai.
I didn't get home until the afternoon.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: She didn't come until eleven.
I finished it in just twenty minutes.
He didn't have lunch until two.
He was up as early as seven.

items.zh: 妈妈说了三次，他就起床。
items.en: Mum had to tell him three times before he got up.
answers: 妈妈说了三次，他才起床。

items.zh: 他很聪明，一个小时才学会了。
items.en: He's clever: he learnt it in just an hour.
answers: 他很聪明，一个小时就学会了。
